Our nine-strong ladies outfit were in good form, bolstered by a return to racing by Nina Mills, now over her injury but short of fitness, and Jacinta Moore, fresh into the vets' scene and raring to go.

We had an individual silver from Pat Newell in the M60 race, together with team gold, and a surprise bronze for the under strength M50 team. In the Ladies 5km race Jacinta Moore ran well for 7th place with Nina Mills in 20th.
